thread:
jordan: FYI Catalyst RFP landed this morning. They want a quick POC + a filled capacity/cost matrix. Attaching initial ask from the AE.
priya: Can you paste the specific RFP asks? I scanned but want to confirm scope (onprem vs hosted, throughput targets).
jordan: Quote from AE: 'need 99.9% availability, 50 qps sustained, on-prem allowed but prefer hosted, SOC2 + HSM, pricing for 6/12/24 mo, canary rollouts required.'
priya: OK. For 50 qps sustained we recommend Dedicated with autoscale burst. Draft capability matrix -> Attached: Catalyst_Capability_Matrix_v1.xlsx
mike: Quick price check: for Dedicated 4xA100 baseline + autoscale to 8, list price is $X/mo, estimate per-token hosted fallback ~ $Y. I'll put exact numbers in the pricing sheet.
daniel: Engineering note: We can support their on-prem requirement but we'd need a week to prepare the private deploy package and KMS integration. Also need to confirm model footprint (2B vs 70B) — which models are in scope?
jordan: They said: primary = open-llama-13B but open to quantized 70B variants.
priya: For POC timeline: propose 3-week plan - week1 infra + private deploy (if requested), week2 dataset injection and evals, week3 acceptance + perf tuning. Need signoff from security on helm/nodes.
sara: Security checklist: will answer questionnaire fields. Short answers: SOC2 Type II (yes, report available), encryption at rest (AES-256), KMS/HSM support (Y), network segmentation (VPC peering), EDR (company EDR - EDR-Vendor). I uploaded redacted SOC2 + HSM whitepaper. Attached: SOC2_redacted.pdf, HSM_integration_note.pdf
security-bot: automated scan of SOC2_redacted.pdf completed — flagged PII redaction OK.
lee: Product: For canary we support traffic split + automatic rollback on latency/error thresholds. Suggest canary 10% for 24h. Also we can provide model variant fallback policy config snippet:
```
routing:
  primary: rlm-open-13b
  fallback: rlm-open-13b-quantized
  policy:
    max_latency_ms: 350
    canary_percent: 10
```
priya: Thanks — @daniel can you confirm resource lead for on-prem package? If not possible, we'll propose hosted with private networking.
daniel: I can take lead but need a week to free up dev resources. If they need <2 weeks start we should recommend hosted Dedicated as interim.
jordan: I'll update the AE with POC plan + attach matrix and security docs. Can everyone ack the matrix final version by EOD? :thumbsup:
priya: ack
sara: ack
daniel: ack
mike: ack
lee: ack
